Eligibility of Tenderer : The documents to be furnished by the supplier shall be as follows
1. Valid VAT Registration Certificate.
2. Valid Trade License.
3.The tenderer must have at least 5 years experience (in place of existing).
4. The tenderer must have the track record of honoring a single tender (Govt./Non-Govt.Organizations ) of min Taka 5 Lac in last
two (02) years.
5. The tenderer/bidder should have the Bank solvency certificate.
6. Tenderer must have a working center/office/branch office in Chattogram City.
7. In order to prove the Tenderer Financial capability necessary to perform the contract, the Tenderer shall furnish the average
annual turnover at least 10 Lac over the last Three (03) years.
8. The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk. 10 Lac.
9. All supply should be as per define catalog.
